name: bumble-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Bumble, a full Bluetooth stack written in Python (host, GATT, profiles,
transports and a virtual controller), used to build Bluetooth applications, emulators and test tools.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the GATT layer, the GATT-based profiles and the transport layer of Bumble: the modules bumble/att.py, bumble/gatt.py, bumble/gatt_server.py, bumble/gatt_client.py, bumble/gatt_adapters.py and bumble/device.py, every module under bumble/profiles/, and every module under bumble/transport/ except the generated gRPC and protobuf code in bumble/transport/grpc_protobuf/, together with every page under docs/mkdocs/src/transports/ and the page docs/mkdocs/src/components/gatt.md, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.

The environment runs Python 3.11 with no network access and no Bluetooth hardware. Bumble is imported
